title: Verity role capability policy
description: Schema for commands/verity/<role>.permissions.json (contracts/role-capability-policy.md v1, ADR-0007) — the runtime-neutral declaration of what a role is ALLOWED to do, projected by each provider driver into that runtime's native controls. This artifact mirrors the zero-dependency validator in verity/bin/lib/agents/policy.cjs exactly. Fail-closed semantics beyond this schema, enforced at load time: a missing or invalid file refuses execution (exit 30) with no fallback to a runtime's default permission surface; every capability key defaults to false when absent; a codex projection that exceeds the capabilities block (workspace-write without write_repository) is schema-valid but LOAD-INVALID; worker overrides may only narrow a projection, never widen it. Capability keys beyond the listed ones are additive v1.x extensions — booleans, defaulting closed.

capabilities.description: The frozen v1 capability vocabulary plus additive v1.x keys. Absence never grants anything.

write_protected_paths.description: Additive v1.x key (stage 9): may the role's own edits touch the protected config roots (.github/**, .verity/**)? When false, the codex driver generates protected-path write-denial rules.

codex.description: The Codex projection — narrower than, never wider than, the capabilities block. 'danger-full-access' is not a legal sandbox value in v1: any future unrestricted mode is a NEW contract with its own explicit opt-in.

ignore_user_config.description: Headless runs ignore the user's global Codex config by default so it cannot change autonomous behavior (ADR-0007); only an explicit false opts out.
